title: 第五章 这合理吗第六章 来了
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 瞧见季南北那副戒备的模样，林梦夕不以为意地摆了摆手。
“不必这般提防，此事对你而言并非坏事。不久之后魔道将有一场盛会，届时会有规模不小的比试较量，奖励还算丰厚。你去历练一番，顺带取些资源回来供己用度。“
季南北闻言，倒是有些意外。
他先前从未听闻过此类消息。
在快活林魔宗也算待了一段时日，虽然平日难见师尊踪影，但与师姐碰面并不算少，为何从未听她提起过?
林梦夕仿佛能洞悉他心中所想，开口道：
“此前未告知于你，是因你修为尚浅，即便去了也无甚用处。如今看来，以你这般精进速度，倒不妨前去一探。“
季南北这才恍然。
“那师姐，这场比试何时举行?地点在何处?对手大致是何等修为?“
林梦夕面色如常地答道：
“一个月后。届时你若能踏入筑基之境，我自会亲自带你前往。对手的修为，大抵也就在这个层次上下。“
季南北：?
师姐，你听听自己说的是人话吗?
“师姐，一个月时间，筑基?这两个词放在一起，合理吗?“
林梦夕认真地点了点头。
“相当合理啊。你这修为进境，几个时辰不见便连破五层境界。照此速度推算，明日你便该筑基了才是。师弟啊，师姐对你可是寄予厚望，好好努力!“努力个鬼!
若非打不过这行事跳脱的师姐，季南北此刻真想动手，将这总爱捉弄人的师姐吊起来好好教训一番。
他连破五境那是凭借外挂机缘所得，更何况练气期前几层与后面层次的突破难度岂能相提并论?
更何况还有筑基这道实实在在的门槛横亘在前!
那位小剑仙当年筑基也耗费了整整一年光阴呢!
林梦夕却全然无视了季南北那近乎死鱼般的眼神，抬手拍了拍他的肩膀。
“师姐很看好你哦!”
语毕，她便身形飘然，转眼不见了踪影。
只留下季南北一人呆立原地，半晌无言。一阵无言过后，季南北索性不再纠结此事。反正尚有一月之期，有系统相助，时间或许真的来得及。
即便来不及......那位师姐总不至于真把自己往绝路上推吧。
暂且放下这桩心事，季南北将注意力转向系统面板。
界面之上清晰显示着他目前持有的魔道点数：三千点。
这是完成先前任务所获。
而魔道点数的用途眼下着实不少。
首要的，便是直接兑换天赋。
当前可兑换的天赋，仅限来自萧京溪的那三项。
天赋“琉璃剑心”，兑换需三百万魔道点。
天赋“同阶无敌“，兑换需十万魔道点。
天赋“正道魁首“，兑换需二十万魔道点。
（注：为助宿主迅速成长，首次夺舍目标之天赋兑换价格降低九成。）
这便是属于萧京溪的三项天赋的标价，而且还是在享受了九折优惠之后。
换言之，若非首次夺舍的目标，兑换这些天赋所需的魔道点数，还得在后面再加一个零。
那简直是个令人咋舌的天文数字!
不过季南北对此早有心理准备。毕竟这三项天赋，每一项的效果都强得超乎常理。
尤其是那“琉璃剑心”，更是萧京溪能稳居同辈之首的根本所在。
幸好有这首次优惠，短期内兑换方有了一丝盼头。然而即便如此，想要攒足点数兑换天赋，仍需完成更多任务。
或者，通过击败强敌、消耗天材地宝进行兑换。
content_en:
Seeing Ji Nanbei's alert look, Lin Mengxi waved her hand indifferently.
"Don't be so careful. This is not a bad thing for you. There will be a grand meeting in the Demonic Path soon, and there will be a large-scale competition, and the rewards will be quite generous. Go and experience it, and get some resources back for your own use."
Ji Nanbei was a little surprised when he heard this.
He had never heard anything like this before.
I have been in the Happy Forest Demon Sect for a while. Although I rarely see my master on weekdays, I have not met my senior sister very often. Why have I never heard her mention it?
Lin Mengxi seemed to be able to understand what he was thinking, and said:
"I didn't tell you before because your cultivation level is still shallow. Even if you go there, it will be of little use. Now it seems that with your speed of improvement, you might as well go and have a look."
Ji Nanbei suddenly realized.
"Sister, when will this competition be held? Where will it be? What is the approximate level of the opponent?"
Lin Mengxi replied with a normal expression:
"One month later. If you can step into the realm of foundation building by then, I will personally take you there. The opponent's cultivation level is probably at this level."
Ji Nanbei:?
Senior sister, do you think what you are saying is human?
"Senior sister, one month to build the foundation? Is it reasonable to put these two words together?"
Lin Mengxi nodded seriously.
"It's quite reasonable. You have advanced to the next level, and you have broken through the fifth level in a few hours. According to this speed, you should build the foundation tomorrow. Junior brother, senior sister has high hopes for you, so work hard! "Work hard!
If he couldn't defeat this senior sister who acted erratically, Ji Nanbei really wanted to take action at this moment and hang up this senior sister who was always teasing people and teach her a lesson.
His breakthrough of five realms in a row was achieved by the chance of cheating. What's more, how can the difficulty of breaking through the first few levels in the Qi training period be comparable to that of the later levels?
What's more, there is a real threshold of foundation building lying in front of us!
That little sword fairy also spent a whole year building the foundation!
Lin Mengxi completely ignored Ji Nanbei's almost dead fish eyes and raised her hand to pat his shoulder.
"Senior sister is very optimistic about you!"
After she finished speaking, her figure drifted away and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Only Ji Nanbei was left standing there, speechless for a long time. After a while of silence, Ji Nanbei simply stopped worrying about the matter. Anyway, there is still one month left, and with the help of the system, there may really be enough time.
Even if it's too late...that senior sister won't really push herself to a dead end.
Putting aside this worry for the time being, Ji Nanbei turned his attention to the system panel.
The number of magic points he currently holds is clearly displayed on the interface: three thousand points.
This is obtained by completing the previous mission.
There are actually many uses for magic points right now.
The first thing is to directly exchange talents.
The currently redeemable talents are only the three from Xiao Jingxi.
The talent "Glass Sword Heart" requires three million magic points to redeem.
The talent "Invincible at the same level" requires 100,000 magic points to redeem.
The talent "Leader of the Righteous Path" requires 200,000 magic points to redeem.
(Note: In order to help the host grow rapidly, the exchange price for the talent of the target for the first time has been reduced by 90%.)
This is the price tag for Xiao Jingxi's three talents, and that's after enjoying a 10% discount.
In other words, if it is not the target of seizing the body for the first time, the magic points required to redeem these talents will have to be followed by a zero.
That is simply a staggering astronomical figure!
However, Ji Nanbei was mentally prepared for this. After all, the effects of each of these three talents are beyond common sense.
Especially the "glazed sword heart" is the fundamental reason why Xiao Jingxi can remain at the top of his peers.
Fortunately, with this first discount, redeemers have a glimmer of hope in the short term. However, even so, if you want to save enough points to redeem talents, you still need to complete more tasks.
Or, redeem them by defeating powerful enemies and consuming heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
